preconditions.description: The length of the string n must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of characters k that can be changed must be between 0 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ab' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist only of the characters 'a' and 'b'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum beauty of the string after changing no more than k characters.
